name: CrowdSec CTI (smoke API and console pages)
tier_rationale: CrowdSec SAS, an established company with published terms, a privacy policy and paid CTI plans (A8 trusted); P152 final condition 1: 'Registry provider crowdsec: tier trusted, terms key-terms'.

reliability.justification: Crowd-sourced signals from CrowdSec agents with scenario-level behaviours, ATT&CK mapping and false-positive classes; a 404 only means 'not in CrowdSec data', never benign (P152 cond 4).

crowdsec.description: CrowdSec CTI API key (x-api-key header; smoke lookups)
crowdsec.plan_hint: the free Community key is for testing and personal servers: record 'business' (key_plans.crowdsec) only for a company-account Premium or paid key (P152 cond 2)

smoke.title: CrowdSec CTI smoke API v2 (GET /v2/smoke/{ip}: reputation, behaviours, classifications, ATT&CK, CVEs)

terms.quote: Licence (legal floor): the Community key is described for testing and personal servers; under the corporate profile it runs only with a company-account Premium or paid key whose plan legal records (key_plans.crowdsec='business'); otherwise SKIPPED reason_code 'licence' with the manual CrowdSec CTI link.

smoke.notes: Quote: binding council text (P152 cond 2). GET https://cti.api.crowdsec.net/v2/smoke/{ip} with header x-api-key only (no bulk ?ips=, search or fire endpoints). Without a key: 403 {'message':'Forbidden'} (research 2026-11-25). 404 = 'not in CrowdSec data' (EMPTY, never benign); 429 = RATE_LIMITED; the monthly budget (Community plan: 120 lookups per month) is the P334 quota block. Provider data is not redistributed: exports shared outside the company carry the verdict, the link and the source name only (P152 cond 7, x_redistribution).
smoke.licensed_alternative: A company-account Premium or paid CrowdSec CTI key recorded as key_plans.crowdsec = 'business'; meanwhile the manual console page threat_intel_g07_p2:crowdsec_cti_ip.

console_links.title: CrowdSec console CTI pages (manual pivot links)

terms.quote: otherwise SKIPPED reason_code 'licence' with the manual CrowdSec CTI link.

console_links.notes: Quote: binding council text (P152 cond 2). app.crowdsec.net/cti/{ip} is a single-page app (not fetched; may ask the analyst to sign in to the console). V3LUM never fetches pivot links itself (P311).

x_redistribution.external_exports: verdict, link and source name only
x_redistribution.basis: P152 cond 7: provider data is not redistributed (CrowdSec CTI EULA: internal use); excluded from STIX/MISP/JSON exports shared outside the company

notes: Owned by batch p2-G07-1 (P152). Quota: the Community plan's 120 lookups per month (published) as a key-scoped P334 month window at 80%; module setting crowdsec_monthly_quota lowers it for a smaller plan, and analyst-typed seeds only spend it (run_on 'seeds', 72 h cache, setting crowdsec_case_budget). retries 0: a 429 is never retried. Error-in-200 and 429 bodies are not captured yet (team-key capture pending, P152 cond 7).
